parsed.why: No trans-specific offence, gender-identity discrimination and hate-crime recording in force, legal recognition reformed; rising anti-LGBT hate-crime reports but no documented state or street targeting of trans people. Border and facilities practice unsourced.

Declaration-based recognition, 'change of sex' protected in discrimination and as hate-crime aggravator; custody placement case-by-case with no birth-sex rule and no segregation practice. No documented trans targeting or criminalisation; gender-expression gap and border practice unsourced.

Penal code Articles 520/517 reach trans visitors as read; no recognition, no complaint route, no registered advocacy. Enforcement documented only in 2010 raids, but armed-group killings and torture plus harshest operative statute place it deep in High Risk.

No criminalisation, low violence, no arbitrary detention, but hate-crime text names only sexual orientation, no gender-identity discrimination ban, no recognition, near-zero visibility; conservatism is friction and thin recourse rather than documented targeting.

Criminalisation enforced, plus advocacy law read to reach gender-identity expression; documented presentation-based arrests and 2023 conviction, police sexual coercion, care denial and impunity. State-implicated targeting, recent and specific, sits below dossier 3.
